summary: Tested the NEW structured availability_schedule feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). 7/7 backend tests pass: PUT /api/profile with availability_schedule persists; user.availability is derived from the schedule keys; GET /api/users/{id} returns availability_schedule; removing a day blocks /apply, /grab, and /assign for that weekday; Profile save (without availability fields) does NOT wipe the schedule. Frontend Playwright flow on mobile viewport (390x844): login as cleaner -> dashboard 'availability-card' shows pills ('Mon · all day', 'Thu · 2 windows', 'Sat · 1 window', etc.) -> tap card opens /availability editor with all 7 day-<Day> cards, switch-<Day>, all-<Day>/custom-<Day>, from-<Day>-<idx>/to-<Day>-<idx>, time-<HH:MM> picker, add-<Day>, remove-<Day>-<idx>, save-availability. Save returns to dashboard and pills update. Profile screen edit-availability button shows the day list summary. Public /employee/<id> page shows 'Availability' card with 'All day' or formatted time ranges (e.g. 'Thu  6:00 AM–11:00 AM, 1:00 PM–6:00 PM'). No deprecated Expo packages or SafeAreaView issues detected in the new availability.tsx code. NOTE: login submit button uses testID 'auth-submit-button' (not 'login-button' as the request suggested).
critical_code_review_comments: availability.tsx save(): on failure the catch block silently swallows the error (no toast/alert) and still navigates back via finally? No — router.back() is in try only, but the user has no feedback if the PUT failed. Consider surfacing an error.
availability.tsx: when toggling a day OFF (deleting from sched) any custom windows are lost; when toggling ON again the user sees 'All day' default. Acceptable UX but worth noting.

Schedule validation is only client-side (filters w.from < w.to before save). Backend /profile accepts any Dict[str, Any] for availability_schedule — no shape validation, no time-format check, no overlap check. Low risk since the UI controls the input, but a malformed schedule (e.g. via curl) would persist.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testIDs reachable, save persists, all displays render correctly)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Test re-asserts the seeded schedule (Mon/Tue/Wed/Fri/Sun all-day, Thu 2 windows 06:00-11:00 & 13:00-18:00, Sat 1 window 08:00-14:00) at the end via TestRestoreSeed so subsequent tests / manual QA see a clean state.
